title: geissospermum laeve
intro: Geissospermum laeve, commonly known as Pericopsis, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia, belonging to the family Fabaceae. The health benefits of Geissospermum laeve include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, that demonstrate antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immune-modulating effects. The bioactive constituents of Geissospermum laeve, such as geissoschizine and 14-deoxygeissoschizine, have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its medicinal properties.
